{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since we need it for mean calculation
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
top_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Display results
top_species"}
